known_limits: Public architecture and protocol material is available.
No live governed interlock trace is retained in the certification record.
No certification-profile negative-control run is retained.
S5 execution/transmission versus S7 proof-verification effect timing remains unresolved in the retained public-source record.
No request/return receipt pair has been retained for an ArquivoNulo-StegVerse interlock run.
missing_requirements: replay evidence for the tested exchange
reconstruction evidence for the tested exchange
retained live trace resolving consequence timing

evidence_request.purpose: Advance only the proposed INT certification profile from evidence-requested to test-ready if the missing evidence is supplied.
minimum_requested_artifacts: Exact ArquivoNulo implementation/version proposed for testing, with immutable locator or artifact hash.
A callable or observable interface through which a bounded governed exchange can be executed.
One declared positive exchange fixture and expected result.
At least one declared negative-control exchange fixture that should fail closed.
Observation points showing when external consequence can bind relative to validation/proof verification.
Request receipt and return receipt for the same exchange identity.
Replay material sufficient to show whether the recorded exchange can be replayed without duplicating consequence.
Reconstruction material sufficient to recover the tested state, inputs, decision/proof path, and observed outcome.
